summary: Unidentified climber fell ~40 ft on the north side of Boulder Canyon after stepping back off the wall without properly clipping his descent device; landed at the base of the wall still high above the highway, requiring a technical evacuation; possible broken ankle and head lacerations; transferred to an AMR ambulance.
responding_agency: Nederland Fire Protection District; Rocky Mountain Rescue; Nederland Police Department
notes: Date approximate: article says only 'Friday afternoon,' published 2015-06-20; 2015-06-12 (Friday) is the edition's preceding Friday -- the defensible pin (2015-06-19 also Friday). Zero Boulder Canyon rows in 2015-06 -- genuinely new. Run 646 Mountain-Ear chunk (this attempt)
